payload.core_mechanism_summary: Aggregate word lengths by distinct letter sets (1 or 2 letters), then compute max total length using up to two letters, with minor sorting to pick top two single-letter groups.
payload.rationale: The solution groups words by character set and greedily combines, sorting only to find the two largest single-letter sums. No search is performed. Closest subtype is sorting_custom_key despite sorting being a minor step.
